inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Part of the wooden barrier on the small playground structure was completely split open and has deep cracks that can lead to skin punctures and splinters.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual with a pending background check was observed caring for children in the preschool classroom.     This was corrected during the inspection when the individual was observed leaving the operation
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers: While interviewing a caregiver they admitted to smoking a vaporizer in front of children while they were outside on the playground.     This was corrected when the director informed me that the caregiver was written up and issued a warning.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Smoking or Use of Tobacco Including E-Cigarettes or Vaporizers (26 TAC §746.3703(d))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: A nail was sticking out of the wooden barrier on the playground
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: There is sufficient evidence to support that  inappropriate discipline is being used when a teacher admitted  using corporal punishment on their child while the child is in daycare
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met: A 14 month old infant was mixed with a toddler classroom during nap time. There were a total of 13 children and the specified age group was two. Due to the child being an infant the caregivers ratio could not be reduced  leaving the teacher out of ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reduction of child/caregiver naptime ratio by 50% allowed, If 13 or more children in care, children are 18 mo. or older and other standards met (26 TAC §746.1613(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Multiple live ants beds were observed on the playground
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: Mushrooms were observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Infants were observed watching Tv on a tablet     This was corrected during the inspection when the director removed the tablet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The playground's mulch is below the specified amount and not being maintained.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Infants were observed watching TV on a tablet during nap time.    This was corrected during the inspection when the director removed the tablet
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 14 month old infant was observed in the toddler classroom and the oldest child was 36 months making it a 18 month difference in age.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The last fire inspection report was dated 02/20/2025 and the fire marshall has not come out yet to conduct the inspection for 2026
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The parent handbook is missing information about infant safe sleep
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: Three mushrooms were observed on one of the swing sets on the playground.     This was corrected during the inspection when I observed the director remove the mushrooms and place them in the trashcan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(6))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The fire inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Based on the information obtained during the investigation conducted by DFPS the infant caregiver admitted to allowing an infant to sleep in a bouncer and denied placing the infant in the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based on the information obtained during the investigation conducted by DFPS it was determined that there were five infants being supervised by one caregiver. Based on the information obtained the caregiver was supervising two four-month-olds, one three-month-old and one fourteen-month-old. The other infants age was undetermined however according to minimum standards the specified age group would be four months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: The carbon monoxide documentation was not available for review.     This was corrected during the inspection when the director tested the alarm and documented the test on the form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The dining room and hallway ceilings were cracked leaving the wood under the ceiling exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings: Multiple bolts were seen sticking out of the black barrier around the playground structure.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Entanglement Protrusions or Openings (26 TAC §746.4601(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An Employee was seen present with out an active background check.     This was corrected at inspection when the director sent the caregiver home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: The fire inspection report was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation uses the procare app for transportation and does not have an emergency medical  form for each child being transported on the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 1 staff record is still missing education documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 1 staff file is still missing the notorized licensing affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There is still broken play equipment in the outdoor play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 10 children's files evaluated were missing current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During the inspection and 8 month old infant was placed in their crib which contained blankets and toys.    Note: The provider removed the items from the crib during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There is broken play equipment in the outdoor play area. The electrical outlets in the after schooler room is missing the outer panel and the inside of the wall is exposed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: One bottle in the infant room was not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: One of the nap cots were not labeled during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: 1 out of 10 staff files evaluated did not contain the notarized licensing affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During the inspection a television was not mounted or anchored in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: During the inspection an infant was sleeping in a bouncer equipped with safety straps.    Note: The provider was instructed to remove the infant and put them in their individual crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR: 3 out of 7 staff files reviewed did not contain a current certificate of CPR and First Aid training completion.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 1 out of 7 staff files evaluated did not contain proof of education.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers: During the inspection infants were sleeping with pacifiers in their mouths that contained an attachment to their clothing.    Note: It was discussed that pacifieres can be used during sleep but must no contain the string or any other attachment to the clothing as it poses a strangulation hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants or Toddlers (26 TAC §746.2401(6))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Certificate: The training certificates for the director were missing for 4 hours of the required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Criteria - Certificate (26 TAC §746.1317(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The feeding sheets for 4 infants have not been updated within the last 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: The nap cots did not contain adequate walking space between each cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Annual fire inspection was not current during inspection. The inspection on file expired since 1/12/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information obtained duirng investigation incident was not shared with parent during pick up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training: One caregiver with no previous experience with child care did not have the required 24 hours of preservice training. Caregiver only had 8 out of the 24 hours of preservice training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers - Pre-service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Logs around the playground swing were loose and there were nails sticking out. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: Fire extinguisher in the vehicle used to transport children have fire extinguisher that was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One out of four staff records checked did not have current first aid cpr training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: One infant bottle was not labeled. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))
